description: 한국전력공사 전남 전주전산화번호 [electricity and power] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력공사. 한국전력공사에서 제공하는 전남 전주전산화번호 데이터입니다. 전남지역 내 전주에 부여된 고유 전산화 번호를 정리한 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 11 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전력공사. Its tags are 한국전력, 전주번호, 번호, 전남, 전산화. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
